about: I am an undergraduate studying mathematics at [Middle East Technical University](https://www.metu.edu.tr/en). During the 2026–2027 academic year, I am an exchange student at [Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg](https://www.uni-wuerzburg.de/en/). My current work focuses on differential geometry and mathematical physics. In the summer of 2026, I worked as a research intern at the [Türkiye National Observatory](https://trgozlemevleri.gov.tr/) with [Prof. Dr. Cahit Yeşilyaprak](https://avesis.atauni.edu.tr/cahity) on adaptive optics and space situational awareness.
